title: The plant is still at it, under its sixth owner
text: The cement works beside the road here is still running, and still the reason Monolith exists. It belongs now to UNACEM, a Peruvian company that bought it from Martin Marietta in the autumn of 2023. That made UNACEM the sixth owner since the city of Los Angeles built the place more than a hundred and fifteen years ago.

s1.title: UNACEM North America
s1.quote: Our Tehachapi cement plant and additional cement terminals ensure dependable supply and efficient delivery for projects throughout Southern California.

s2.title: UNACEM completes acquisition of Tehachapi cement plant
s2.quote: Peru-based UNACEM has completed its acquisition of the Tehachapi cement plant in California from Martin Marietta Materials.

s3.title: Tehachapi cement plant reported sold to Peruvian firm
s3.quote: UNACEM would become the sixth owner of the plant since its construction by the city of Los Angeles more than 115 years ago.
